features.body: Know where every crane, roller, and excavator is across multiple projects. View availability and usage from anywhere, and request an immediate update from the site manager through the app. SiteFlow works as a full equipment fleet management solution across sites.

faqs.q: What is SiteFlow construction equipment management software?
faqs.a: SiteFlow is a cloud-based platform that helps construction companies track, manage, and optimize their fleet of owned and rented equipment, with real-time visibility into asset location, usage hours, fuel consumption, and maintenance schedules.

faqs.q: How does SiteFlow verify hired equipment bills before payment?
faqs.a: Every hired machine logs its site-recorded usage hours and fuel. SiteFlow compares those system records against the vendor invoice so rental bills are verified against actual running time before any payment is approved.

faqs.q: Can SiteFlow track both owned and hired equipment in the same system?
faqs.a: Yes. Owned assets and hired machinery live in one fleet register, so allocation, cost, and utilization are visible side by side across all your sites.

cta.heading: Ready to maximize your fleet utilization?
cta.body: Stop paying for idle equipment and start tracking every asset with precision. Bring owned and hired fleets into one verified view with SiteFlow.
